description: Napster 1.0.0 — major release: Performance & reliability improvements, UI polish, and repository cleanup.

changelog.title: Performance & Reliability (Phase 9)
items: Removed blocking DataStore reads from ExoPlayer main-thread callbacks. Preferences are now cached reactively.
Search suggestion debounce (300 ms) reduces InnerTube requests during rapid typing.
Room play-count writes are now fully atomic using @Transaction; removed all blocking runBlocking calls.
YouTube fallback latency reduced: terminal errors abort early without exhausting all 12 clients.
Home feed and Android Auto search queries are now bounded, eliminating full-table memory dumps.

changelog.title: Smart Discovery & Spotify Integration
items: Public Spotify playlist import: paste a Spotify playlist link to resolve tracks via YouTube.
Dynamic Spotify recommendations seeded by recently played tracks.
Smooth fallback to related artist and album mixes when primary recommendations are unavailable.

changelog.title: Theme Presets
items: One-tap theme presets: Deep Midnight OLED, Cyberpunk Neon, Emerald Frosted Glass, Rose Gold, Sunset Amber, and Dynamic Material You.
Live gradient preview tiles with instant whole-app theme adaptation.
Presets export and import as .napsterpreset archives.

changelog.title: Audio & Playback Polish
items: One-tap playback presets: Normal, Sped Up, Nightcore, Slowed, Daycore, and Vaporwave.
DJ mode with beat-matched transitions and energy profiling.
Accessible from both the Player Menu and Song Options.
